message.reasoning:
We need to generate a test class covering all cases from JSON. The provided test class already covers some cases (customizer flow, without customizer). Need to add more tests for other groups: FailFast Assertion Exception Handling, Null Parameter Handling, Empty Validation Result, Customizer Exception Propagation, OutputFormat Exception Propagation, Null ValidationMessage Set Handling, Null ValidationContext Handling, Null ExecutionContext After Customize, Internal Validation RuntimeException Propagation.

We must use JUnit5, Mockito. Use reflection to set validationContext to null for that case. For FailFastAssertionException, we need to mock schemaSpy.validate(executionContext, node) to throw FailFastAssertionException with getValidationMessages returning set.

Need to import necessary classes: FailFastAssertionException, ValidationMessage, ValidationContext, etc.

Also need to test NullPointerException cases: when executionContext null, format null, node null. Since method will call outputFormat.customize first, which will NPE if format null because we call method on null. For executionContext null, format.customize will be called with null executionContext; we expect NPE from inside format.customize (since we mock format to just be called, but passing null may cause NPE in our mock? Actually calling a mock method with null argument does not throw NPE; but spec says NPE is thrown when format.customize is invoked with null ExecutionContext. To simulate, we can make the mock's customize method throw NPE when executionContext is null. Or we can let the method call and then after that internal validate will throw NPE due to null executionContext. The description says NPE thrown when format.customize is invoked with null ExecutionContext. So we can set up mock outputFormat to throw NPE when customize called with null. Use doThrow(new NullPointerException()).when(outputFormat).customize(isNull(), any());

Similarly for format null: calling method with null format will cause NPE before any method call. So we just call schemaSpy.validate(..., null, ...) expecting NPE.

For node null: internal validation will be called with null node, which may cause NPE; we can stub schemaSpy.validate to call real method? Actually we are testing outer method; internal validate is called via schemaSpy.validate(executionContext, node). Since we are spying, we can let the real method execute, but the real internal validate may handle null differently. Safer: we can let the spy call the real method but we don't have the real behavior; easier: we can stub the internal validate to throw NPE when node is null. Use doThrow(new NullPointerException()).when(schemaSpy).validate(eq(executionContext), isNull());

Empty Validation Result: internal validate returns empty set; outputFormat returns empty list.

Customizer Exception Propagation: mock executionCustomizer.customize to throw RuntimeException; verify exception propagates and format.format not called.

OutputFormat Exception Propagation: two cases: customize throws RuntimeException (no validation, no format.format). Another: format.format throws RuntimeException after validation.

Null ValidationMessage Set Handling: internal validate returns null; format.format returns something; ensure called with null set.

Null ValidationContext Handling: need to set schemaSpy's validationContext field to null via reflection. Then when outputFormat.customize attempts to use it, we can make the mock throw NPE when called with any ValidationContext (null). Actually the method passes validationContext (field) to customize; if it's null, the mock's customize will receive null for second argument; we can set up mock to throw NPE when second argument is null. Use doThrow(new NullPointerException()).when(outputFormat).customize(any(), isNull());

Null ExecutionContext After Customize: format.customize does nothing (no exception) even with null executionContext. Then internal validate with null executionContext should throw NPE. So we set executionContext null, mock outputFormat.customize to doNothing (default). Then stub internal validate to throw NPE when executionContext null. Use doThrow(new NullPointerException()).when(schemaSpy).validate(isNull(), any());

Internal Validation RuntimeException Propagation: make internal validate throw IllegalStateException; ensure outer method propagates.

We need to include imports for List, etc.

Make test methods separate, each with @Test and proper naming.

Parameterize where appropriate? Could combine similar null parameter tests using @ParameterizedTest with CsvSource. But we can keep separate for clarity.

Make sure to reset mocks after each test (already done). Use schemaSpy = Mockito.spy(realSchema) each test.

Now produce final code.
